method: Reviewed official manufacturer product indices, model comparison, manual and heritage gallery via web retrieval. Only factual model identities and device type transcribed; no descriptions/specifications copied.
scope: Complete turntables; no components, compatibility, dates, dimensions, speed/cartridge/colour variants, or claim of serviceability. Thorens TD1600/1601 are model families regardless of fitted tonearm, not tonearm products.

groups.access_note: German product URL resolves through manufacturer redirect to /en/products/ in delegated web retrieval; primary review could not access /en/products/ directly. Product index and support navigation each name all eight exact CS models; support has no CS629Q manual, so no manual is claimed for it.
Manufacturer search-indexed complete comparison table verifies these ten model identities. Direct PDF open returned 404 in primary review; no fresh origin HTTP200 or downloaded PDF is claimed.

part_scope.evidence: Official CS329 spare list identifies cartridge, aluminium platter, belt and tonearm subparts. Root-requested regression vocabulary also includes stylus as English needle terminology. These nouns describe parts, not complete turntables; they add no cross-model compatibility assertion.
